name: duopore-public-supplied-funnel-conversion
description: See where counts fall between steps in a sales or sign-up funnel.

interface.longDescription: See where counts fall between steps in a sales or sign-up funnel. Enter the steps in order and the count for the same group at each step. Get step-by-step and overall conversion and drop-off figures. Counts must not rise at a later step. The app uses your totals only; it does not track people or explain why they left.
defaultPrompt: Calculate conversion and drop-off for these funnel steps.
Which step has the biggest drop in these counts?

positive.prompt: Use Funnel Conversion Worksheet with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs.
